ns2:course.label: Political Economy
ns2:course.description: Microeconomic analysis of political decision making processes. Includes social choice, models of political competition, game-theoretic analysis of political institutions and lobbying. Same as PS 548. Prerequisite: ECON 500 or equivalent, or instructor's consent.
ns2:course.courseSectionInformation: Same as PS 548. Prerequisite: ECON 500 or equivalent, or instructor's consent.
